extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: general cargo ship (feeder), stylized and shortened to approx. 38.4 x 10.5 x 18.2 m (L x W x H incl. masts, cranes and lifeboat davits, hull beam 8.5 m), carrying 14 standard 20 ft containers
extras.notes: bow faces -Y; stands on its flat bottom at z = 0, add your own water (waterline at 2.1 m: blue boot stripe above the antifouling); three hatches with closed covers and plain 20 ft containers without text; separate moving parts with origin on their axis: cargo-ship_crane_aft / _fore (crane house, jib and hook, slew around Z on the pedestal), cargo-ship_propeller (spins around the shaft), cargo-ship_rudder (turns around Z); opaque tinted windows, no interior; no name, no text, no flag, no brand

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
